description.blurb: S/2005 S 4 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Inuit group. It was discovered in 2005 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2005 S 4 is about 5 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 11.3 million km in 450.22 days. It has an inclination of 48.0° to the ecliptic in a prograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.315.
